SELECT a.transaction_time, a.user_card, a.transaction_count, a.transaction_type, a.dep_name, a.subsidy_begin_date, a.subsidy_end_date, a.transaction_status, b.user_serial, b.user_no, b.user_name FROM copies_change_record a LEFT JOIN account b ON a.user_card = b.user_card
1=1
and a.transaction_type=#{param.transactionType}
and b.user_card like CONCAT('%',#{param.enterParam},'%') or b.user_serial like CONCAT('%',#{param.enterParam},'%') or b.user_no like CONCAT('%',#{param.enterParam},'%') or b.user_name like CONCAT('%',#{param.enterParam},'%')
and a.transaction_time between to_timestamp(#{startTime},'yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss') and to_date(#{endTime},'yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss')
order by a.transaction_time desc

SELECT a.`transaction_time`, a.`user_card`, a.`transaction_count`, a.`transaction_type`, a.`dep_name`, a.`subsidy_begin_date`, a.`subsidy_end_date`, a.`transaction_status`, b.`user_serial`, b.`user_no`, b.`user_name` FROM `copies_change_record` a LEFT JOIN `account` b ON a.`user_card` = b.`user_card`
1=1
and a.`transaction_type`=#{param.transactionType}
and b.`user_card` like CONCAT('%',#{param.enterParam},'%') or b.`user_serial` like CONCAT('%',#{param.enterParam},'%') or b.`user_no` like CONCAT('%',#{param.enterParam},'%') or b.`user_name` like CONCAT('%',#{param.enterParam},'%')
and a.`transaction_time` between to_timestamp(#{startTime},'yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss') and to_date(#{endTime},'yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss')
order by a.`transaction_time` desc

SELECT ( sum( CASE a.transaction_type WHEN 4 THEN a.transaction_count ELSE 0 END )) AS '份补贴', ( sum( CASE a.transaction_type WHEN 2 THEN a.transaction_count ELSE 0 END )) AS '份消费', ( sum( CASE a.transaction_type WHEN 6 THEN a.transaction_count ELSE 0 END )) AS '份清零' FROM copies_change_record a LEFT JOIN account b ON a.user_card = b.user_card
1=1
and b.user_card like CONCAT('%',#{param.enterParam},'%') or b.user_serial like CONCAT('%',#{param.enterParam},'%') or b.user_no like CONCAT('%',#{param.enterParam},'%') or b.user_name like CONCAT('%',#{param.enterParam},'%')
and a.transaction_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime}
